title: Excess Flood Rate Manual — Renewal Term Premium Worksheet
content:
The renewal term premium of an **Excess Flood Policies (Surplus Lines)** policy is figured as follows.

## Formal clause

The renewal term premium starts from the scheduled layer charge: the excess dwelling limit divided by 1,000 times the tier's dwelling rate per 1,000, plus the excess personal property limit divided by 1,000 times the tier's personal property rate per 1,000. The scheduled layer charge is multiplied by the zone factor that the tier's zone factor table gives the flood zone on the policy record and by the elevation multiplier. The elevation multiplier is one less the tier's elevation credit percentage where the policy record carries an accepted Elevation Certificate showing the lowest floor at least the tier's credit threshold in whole feet above the base flood elevation, and one where it does not. The tier's loss-of-use charge is then added, the sum is rounded to the cent once, and the renewal term premium is never less than the tier's minimum premium.

## Zone factors

| Flood zone on the policy record | Zone factor |
|---|---|
| X, B or C | 0.3 |
| A99 or AR | 0.6 |
| AO | 0.9 |
| D | 1.2 |
| V or VE | 2.75 |
| A, AE, AH and any other zone | 1.0 |

The limits, the flood zone, the certificate on file and its whole-foot figure are read from the excess policy record; the rates, the credit, the threshold, the loss-of-use charge and the minimum premium are the tier's own figures. Where two entries on a file share the date they are read by, or two policy records answer the same description, the one entered first is read.

## Worksheet (hypothetical figures, not a tier's)

| Line | Entry | Amount |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | Excess dwelling limit 400000 divided by 1,000, times a dwelling rate of 2.00 | 800.00 |
| 2 | Excess personal property limit 100000 divided by 1,000, times a personal property rate of 3.00 | 300.00 |
| 3 | Scheduled layer charge (line 1 plus line 2) | 1100.00 |
| 4 | Times the zone factor for zone AO, 0.9 | 990.00 |
| 5 | Times the elevation multiplier: certificate on the record shows 3 whole feet, credit 15 percent, multiplier 0.85 | 841.50 |
| 6 | Plus a loss-of-use charge of 100.00, rounded to the cent once | 941.50 |
| 7 | Compared with a minimum premium of 500.00 — the higher stands | 941.50 |

Had the record shown no accepted certificate, line 5 would stay at 990.00 and the premium would be 1090.00. Had line 6 come to 480.00, the renewal term premium would be the minimum, 500.00.
